Grenoble, France (EMEA)
Senior Backend Engineer & Solutions Architect – Applied Generative AI Integration, API Orchestration, Structured Data (XML/JSON), SaaS Integrations.

Senior backend engineer and solutions architect with 25+ years of experience building production services and integration-heavy platforms (APIs, workflows, data pipelines) across SaaS and enterprise systems. Recent focus on applied generative AI: integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI) into multi-step orchestration workflows, producing schema-constrained structured outputs (JSON Schema, XML/XSD), and implementing validation/error-handling to make AI outputs reliable for downstream services. Strong background in SaaS integrations (CRM/ERP/partners), observability (dashboards/log analysis), and iterative delivery with cross-functional teams in distributed contexts.

li.p: LLM API integration: OpenAI API integration patterns for production services (contract-first I/O, repeatable execution, integration testing).
LLM pipeline orchestration (framework-like): multi-step workflows, response memory, JSONPath-based reuse, conditional execution, delays, reusable sub-workflows.
Structured output generation & parsing: schema-constrained generation targeting deterministic downstream use (JSON Schema, XML/XSD); parsing and validation pipelines.
Robustness: explicit error handling, deterministic validation, failure-mode design, end-to-end scenario testing for AI-assisted workflows.
REST APIs & integrations: OpenAPI/Swagger, API Platform, webhooks, OAuth2; multi-system workflows (CRM/ERP/partners).
Integration architecture: ESB-like orchestration and data synchronization; bridging heterogeneous stacks and data models.
Core stack experience: PHP/Symfony (high-traffic web platforms and APIs), Ballerina (API orchestration/services/jobs), Java/J2EE (service platforms).
Observability: dashboards, log analysis, KPIs (including Kibana-based monitoring).
CI/CD & delivery: GitHub/GitLab workflows, code reviews, Docker, Linux; iterative, backlog-driven delivery (Jira/Confluence).
TypeScript (related): Angular/TypeScript maintenance in production (API consumption, WebSocket events, UI component maintenance) and tight front/back API contract collaboration.
Python (related): Odoo ERP integrations and Python customizations (PostgreSQL) in data-centric workflows.
Rust (WIP): design of a backend execution engine for LLM workflows (parsing/validation/error handling, API-first design).

Rust-based LLM Processing Engine (Work in Progress)
Role: Senior Software Engineer / Architect
Dates: Oct 2025 – Present
Summary: Design and implementation of a Rust backend execution service for LLM-driven data processing workflows: LLM calls, structured parsing, schema validation (JSON Schema, XML/XSD), and deterministic error handling. Designed for integration within a multi-service architecture with strict separation between orchestration, execution, and communication layers.
Technologies: Rust (async), REST APIs, OpenAI API integration patterns, JSON Schema, XML/XSD validation, HTTP/JSON, Git/GitHub, Linux.

Senior Lead Developer & Architect – Applied AI integration & SaaS/enterprise workflows
Company: Cosmobilis – Chambéry, France

tchatAPI.org – LLM-enabled API workflow orchestration engine (product demo / R&D) (Oct 2024 – Present, Solo Developer)
Designed and implemented a Ballerina-based orchestration engine to execute schema-driven, multi-step API workflows (typed request hierarchy, reusable sub-workflows). Integrated OpenAI API as a managed request type to embed AI-assisted steps within workflows. Implemented execution primitives required for production-grade orchestration: response memorization, JSONPath-based reuse, conditional execution, delays, and validation-oriented control flow. Exposed execution via CLI and OpenAPI/Swagger UI for reproducible runs, inspection, and debugging.
References: http://www.tchatapi.org ; https://github.com/sitedesc/bal_apps/tree/main/apps/chatapi/srv_opportunity

CMS-integrated CV retro-conversion & targeted CV generation (LLM + structured outputs)
Built an automated workflow converting free-text CV inputs into schema-driven XML via OpenAI API orchestrated in Ballerina, stored in BaseX, editable through WYSIWYG authoring, and published as PDF/HTML. Implemented schema-constrained generation/validation (XML/XSD) to ensure reliable structured outputs for downstream formatting and editing pipelines.
Demo: http://www.sitems.org:16386/cms/dictionary

Enterprise Application Integration Service (CRM <-> ERP) (Jan 2024 – Present, Lead Developer)
Built and maintained API-based integration between Salesforce and OpenFlex ERP for leads/opportunities workflows (mapping, synchronization, multi-country scenarios). Evolved architecture toward message-oriented, observable orchestration; introduced async execution patterns via Ballerina services. Implemented end-to-end automated scenario tests to detect regressions before production impact.
Stack: PHP/Symfony (3–6), API Platform/OpenAPI, webhooks, OAuth2, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Docker/AWS, GitHub CI/CD.

Lead developer across multi-country, high-traffic platforms: maintained partner integrations (search, CRM, marketplaces, mailing, image services), stabilized API contracts, and supported production operations (CI/CD, Docker/AWS deployments, monitoring and incident analysis).
TypeScript/Angular experience: maintained production Angular/TypeScript front-end applications consuming REST APIs; WebSocket-based real-time updates; UI component maintenance and coordinated front/back releases.
